ios.desc:
If you have so many subscriptions that you’ve lost track of them and hate unexpected charges, Subscription Day is built exactly for this.

Subscription Day is a simple and powerful subscription calendar for iOS & Mac. No clutter. Only what really matters.

• Visual Calendar: See the current month and all upcoming payments at a glance.
• Widgets. Quickly check your most important subscription information right from your Home Screen.
• Subscription Types: Supports monthly subscriptions, yearly plans, trial versions, one time purchases, and fully custom billing periods.
• Smart Notifications: Set reminders so you never miss a charge or forget to cancel a trial.
• Highlights: Easily flag important items like annual, trial, or one‑time payments.
• Statistics and Insights: Get a clear overview of your projected yearly budget, average monthly costs, and peak spending months with a clean radial chart.
• Personal/Work/Custom Lists: Separate subscriptions into Personal and Work lists and track budgets and statistics independently.
• Custom own categories: Organize subscriptions using your own categories exactly the way you prefer.
• Multi-Currency Support: Supports 150+ currencies with automatic conversion so everything is shown in your selected currency.
• Status Management: Mark subscriptions as active or canceled and keep your statistics always accurate.
• Quick Addition: Start typing a service name and get automatic suggestions including logo, category, and color. You can also choose emojis or symbols for custom avatars.
• Smart Import Manager: Import subscriptions in one click from Notion, Google Sheets, or from any text file in any structure. You can also import directly from the App Store by recognizing subscriptions from screenshots.
• Generate period based PDF reports for accountants and employers & export your data
• iCloud Sync: Your subscriptions stay in sync across all your devices.
• iPad Support.

Important note:
Subscription Day does not automatically detect or fetch your subscriptions. You add them manually or use the smart import manager to bring in existing subscription lists from your documents and tools. Subscription Day is constantly evolving. We actively listen to user feedback and would love to hear your ideas via email.

Have a great day.

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a macOS app to track your paid subscriptions

quotes.text:
Hi HN

I built a small app to help people track their paid subscriptions (like Netflix, Spotify, etc.). I made this because I personally kept forgetting about old subscriptions draining my money every month.

The app is free with some limitations. There’s a 50% discount available until April 6.

## Future Plans

- Ability to add subscriptions with custom periods: 1 week, 3 months, 2 years, etc.
- Option to track subscription price changes over time
- Tags for easier filtering and organization
- Search and list view with sorting by any value
- Light mode design
- Sync with Calendar/Reminders for notifications on iPhone/iPad/Watch
- Option to switch the app mode from Menu Bar to a regular window

## Secret Bonus

Try shaking the PRO purchase window — the bubbles in the background should react with inertia. I’m pretty proud of that little effect

Would love to hear your feedback and suggestions
